name: Link Jira Issues
description: Creates a link between two Jira issues (e.g. 'Blocks', 'Relates', 'Duplicate'). Use to link, block, or relate two issues.
author: anything-jira

input.hint: Base URL of your Jira Server / Data Center instance.
Jira Data Center Personal Access Token. Sent as a Bearer token. Stored locally in this skill's plugin.json.

inwardIssue.description: The first issue key (the 'from' side), e.g. 'ENG-1'. Required.

outwardIssue.description: The second issue key (the 'to' side), e.g. 'ENG-2'. Required.

linkType.description: The link type name as defined in your Jira, e.g. 'Blocks', 'Relates', 'Duplicate'. Defaults to 'Relates'.
